title: ID0383422-DC/Si-D/FR-[ZJvBNA]- Terminal candidate list empty
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
No transactions processed
Root cause:
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Warranty Status: Yes
Hello,
The terminal on this charger has never processed any transactions,
even after being replaced. Do the logs show that the issue is with
the reader corA10, with the message 'Error message: Terminal
candidate list empty'?
Thank you in advance
